messages:
maria (Design): quick accessibility/ux nit — the small undo confirmation toast uses the CTA label 'Dismiss' but visually the button reads 'Undo'. Screen reader says 'Close' on the button. :thinking_face:
jon (PM): oof. that's confusing. did we change the copy recently?
alex (Frontend): we pulled in a component update last sprint that standardized to 'Dismiss' for toasts, but the inline text stayed 'Undo'.
sam (a11y): this creates a mismatch between visible text and aria-label. SR users will hear a different affordance than sighted users expect. also keyboard focus order: after the modal confirms, focus jumps to body instead of the element that triggered the action. :warning:
maria (Design): suggested fixes: 1) make visible text and aria-label match (e.g., `Undo` -> `Undo last save` to be explicit). 2) ensure the toast CTA has `aria-describedby` linking to the toast message for context. 3) restore focus to the triggering control after modal/toast flow.
jon (PM): sounds good. i prefer `Undo last save` over just `Undo` — less ambiguous for users.
alex (Frontend): i'll change the component props: set `aria-label` to the CTA text and add optional `aria-describedby` prop. also will add a focus-return util for modals. plan to open a PR today.
maria (Design): can you also update the Figma token and the copy table? small microcopy entry: 
```
Toast message: "Saved — changes are live."
Toast CTA: "Undo last save"
Button aria-label: "Undo last save"
sr-only description id: "toast-undo-desc" content: "Restores document to previous version"
```
jon (PM): add a regression test in e2e that asserts `document.activeElement` returns to the trigger after modal close.
sam (a11y): make sure we run this with VoiceOver/NVDA. also check the toast doesn't grab focus when it appears (should be announced but not focusable unless invoked). :white_check_mark:
alex (Frontend): noted. i'll include both unit + cypress test. PR will reference this thread.
maria (Design): small wording nit for the save message — change `Saved — changes are live.` to `Saved. Your changes are live.` feels clearer when read by screen readers.
jon (PM): agree. tiny but important.
design-bot: deployment scheduled: canary for `frontend/components/toast` at 2026-03-24T13:30:00Z.
alex (Frontend): thanks — PR up at #4123, includes copy update, aria fix, focus util, unit + e2e tests. linking the snippet in the PR description.
maria (Design): great, will review the PR and update Figma. tagging @sam for a11y review during code review. :sparkles:
sam (a11y): will do a quick pass after PR lands. thanks for flagging this! :a11y:
